title: Seed-Coder: Let the Code Model Curate Data for Itself
paper_type_zh: 代码模型数据构造与推理后训练技术报告
best_for_zh: 研究代码语料过滤、synthetic SFT、execution feedback、DPO、RLVR 与数据审计的读者
one_line: Seed-Coder builds a 6T curriculum with external-teacher quality scoring, then adds 3M SFT, 20K sandbox-derived preferences, and 250-step LongCoT GRPO while withholding data, scorer, tests, rewards, and lineage.
Seed-Coder 用外部 teacher 标注与 1.3B scorer 构造 6T-token curriculum，再加入 3M SFT、20K sandbox preference 与 250-step LongCoT GRPO，但未发布数据、scorer、测试、reward 或记录级 lineage。
why: It shows how learned filters and executable feedback shape a code model while exposing teacher, language, formatting, generated-test, licensing, and leakage risks.
inclusion_reason: A detailed end-to-end code-model data recipe from learned corpus filtering through synthetic SFT, sandbox preferences, and LongCoT GRPO, with important bias, feedback-loop, decontamination, and license gaps.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Seed-Coder: Let the Code Model Curate Data for Itself is a 2025 arXiv report from ByteDance Seed with official code, project, and Base/Instruct/Reasoning weights. It asks how to scale code-model training data with less hand-written filtering, then follows the lifecycle from GitHub and web acquisition through learned quality scoring, continued pretraining, synthetic SFT, DPO, LongCoT warmup, and GRPO.

The title requires a boundary: initial code-quality ground truth comes from DeepSeek-V2-Chat; unspecified external LLMs synthesize and judge SFT data and tests; DeepSeek-R1/open traces supply reasoning warmup. Only later DPO candidates and GRPO rollouts are explicitly generated by Seed-Coder policies. “Self-curation” therefore means model-centric construction, not a target model independently creating and verifying every record.

The data objects include files, repository sequences, 74M commits from 140K filtered repositories, web code documents, FIM sequences, instruction-response pairs, generated solution/test/revision traces, chosen/rejected pairs, and long-CoT coding trajectories. The release contains weights and recipe descriptions but not data, the 1.3B scorer, generator prompts, tests, sandbox, preference records, reward code, or record lineage.

This Card belongs in the frontier disclosure ledger because the paper gives unusually concrete counts and training settings while retaining material uncertainty about feedback validity, provenance, licenses, and reproducibility.

Seed-Coder: Let the Code Model Curate Data for Itself 是 ByteDance Seed 的 2025 arXiv 报告，配有官方代码、项目页和 Base/Instruct/Reasoning 权重。它研究如何减少手写过滤并扩展代码模型训练数据，覆盖 GitHub/web 获取、学习式质量评分、continued pretraining、synthetic SFT、DPO、LongCoT warmup 与 GRPO 全生命周期。

标题需要边界说明：初始代码质量 ground truth 来自 DeepSeek-V2-Chat；未具名外部 LLM 合成并判断 SFT 数据与测试；DeepSeek-R1/open trace 提供 reasoning warmup。只有后期 DPO candidate 与 GRPO rollout 明确由 Seed-Coder policy 生成。因此“self-curation”是 model-centric construction，而不是目标模型独立生成并验证全部记录。

数据对象包括文件、repository sequence、来自 140K 个筛选 repository 的 74M commits、web code document、FIM sequence、instruction-response pair、生成的 solution/test/revision trace、chosen/rejected pair 与 long-CoT coding trajectory。发布物包含权重和 recipe 描述，但不包含数据、1.3B scorer、generator prompt、test、sandbox、preference record、reward code 或记录级 lineage。

本 Card 属于前沿披露台账，因为论文给出异常具体的规模与训练设置，同时在反馈有效性、provenance、license 和复现方面仍有关键不确定性。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central mechanism is a cascade of learned and executable filters. DeepSeek-V2-Chat scores 222,066 files from 21 languages on a 0-10 quality scale. A pretrained 1.3B Llama-2-structured regressor is fine-tuned for one epoch to imitate those labels and removes the relative bottom approximately 10% before filtering an 89-language corpus. This is teacher imitation, not independent code correctness.

For web recall, 10M candidates are split 70/30 for fastText seeding/validation; the reported recall is 99% and precision 45%, yielding roughly 3% of Common Crawl as code-related candidates before later LLM scoring. Continued-pretraining positives start from about 100K seeds plus random/hard negatives and expand for 2-3 fastText rounds. These stages increase coverage but can propagate teacher and false-positive bias.

Post-training changes the feedback object. SFT combines LLM generation, model correctness/difficulty judgments, syntax checks, and generated-test self-correction. DPO turns on-policy candidates into about 20K preference pairs using generated-code/generated-test execution. LongCoT GRPO uses executable correctness and format signals. The exact reward formula, sandbox, compiler/runtime matrix, tests, parser, weights, normalization, and exploit controls remain unknown.

The closest comparison is DeepSeek-R1-style execution-verifiable reasoning, but Seed-Coder adds an end-to-end corpus construction and synthetic instruction pipeline. Its direction value is showing how a chain of model scorers and generated tests becomes an implicit training objective.

核心机制是一串学习式与可执行 filter。DeepSeek-V2-Chat 对 21 种语言的 222,066 个文件按 0–10 质量打分；一个 pretrained 1.3B、Llama-2-style regression model 训练一轮以模仿标签，再移除相对 bottom approximately 10%，之后作用于 89-language corpus。这是 teacher imitation，不是独立代码正确性。

Web recall 对 10M candidates 进行 70/30 fastText seed/validation 划分，报告 recall 99%、precision 45%，在后续 LLM scoring 前将约 3% Common Crawl 识别为 code-related candidates。Continued-pretraining positive 从约 100K seeds 与 random/hard negatives 开始，进行 2–3 轮 fastText 扩张。这增加覆盖，也可能传播 teacher 与 false-positive bias。

后训练改变反馈对象。SFT 结合 LLM generation、模型 correctness/difficulty judgment、syntax check 与 generated-test self-correction。DPO 用 generated-code/generated-test execution 把 on-policy candidates 转成约 20K preference pairs。LongCoT GRPO 使用可执行 correctness 与 format signal。确切 reward formula、sandbox、compiler/runtime matrix、test、parser、weight、normalization 与 exploit control 未知。

最近的比较是 DeepSeek-R1 式 execution-verifiable reasoning，但 Seed-Coder 还加入端到端 corpus construction 与 synthetic instruction pipeline。其方向价值是揭示模型 scorer 与 generated test 链条如何成为隐式训练目标。

title: Method
方法
html:
The reconstructable pipeline is:

  1. Acquire and filter code. Apply SHA256 exact deduplication, MinHash near deduplication, and Tree-sitter parsing to GitHub data. Train the 1.3B quality regressor for one epoch on 222,066 DeepSeek-V2-Chat-labeled files; remove the relative bottom ~10%. The retained GitHub corpus is about 1T unique tokens over 89 languages.
  2. Construct commit/web/continued data. Build about 100B commit tokens from 74M commits in 140K repositories meeting popularity/maintenance thresholds. Recall web code from 10M candidates with fastText (99% recall, 45% precision), then LLM-score/category-filter to about 1.2T tokens. Expand about 100K high-quality seeds for 2-3 rounds to about 130B tokens. Build about 1T long-context continued-pretraining tokens and extend context 8K to 32K.
  3. Pretrain 6T tokens. Train the 8.2B Base on 1T code/math web at LR 3e-4, then 4T curated code at the same LR; reduce LR by sqrt(10) for 400B continued tokens and use 3e-5 for the final 600B.
  4. SFT and DPO. Filter synthesized records by syntax, correctness, and difficulty >=3/10; self-correct difficult examples against generated tests. Retain about 3M SFT pairs and train three epochs at LR 2e-5 with packing. Sample hundreds of on-policy candidates per prompt and retain about 20K sandbox-derived DPO pairs; DPO beta, LR, epochs, and selection details are unknown.
  5. LongCoT warmup and RL. Rejection-sample DeepSeek-R1/open CoT solutions, retain thousands, and warm Base at LR 2e-5. GRPO via verl uses batch 128, LR 1e-6, temperature 0.6, no KL, clip 0.28, token-wise loss, overlong filtering, and removal of prompts above 87.5% correctness. Run 90 steps at 16K with 16 rollouts/prompt, then 160 at 32K with 32 rollouts/prompt.

Total GRPO trajectories cannot be reconstructed without prompt batching, discarded groups, failures, and resampling. No reward formula or sandbox implementation is inferred.

可重建的流程如下：

  1. 获取与过滤代码。 GitHub 数据采用 SHA256 精确去重、MinHash 近似去重和 Tree-sitter 解析。1.3B 质量回归器在 222,066 个由 DeepSeek-V2-Chat 标注的文件上训练一轮，移除相对排名末尾约 10% 的文件；最终得到约 1T 个唯一 token，覆盖 89 种语言。
  2. 构造提交、网页与续训数据。 从满足热度和维护阈值的 140K 个代码仓库、74M 次提交中构造约 100B token。先用 fastText 从 10M 个候选样本中召回网页代码（召回率 99%、精确率 45%），再经 LLM 和类别过滤得到约 1.2T token。约 100K 个高质量种子经 2–3 轮扩张得到约 130B token。长上下文续训使用约 1T token，上下文长度由 8K 扩至 32K。
  3. 6T-token 预训练。 8.2B Base 先以 LR 3e-4 在 1T token 的代码与数学网页数据上训练，再以相同 LR 在 4T token 的精选代码上训练；随后 400B 个续训 token 的 LR 降至原来的 1/sqrt(10)，最后 600B token 使用 3e-5。
  4. SFT 与 DPO。 合成记录按语法、正确性和难度不低于 3/10 的条件过滤；困难样本借助生成测试进行自我修正。最终保留约 3M 个 SFT 样本对，以 LR 2e-5 采用样本拼接训练三轮。每个提示采样数百个同策略候选，保留约 20K 个由沙箱执行结果构造的 DPO 样本对；DPO 的 beta、LR、训练轮数和选择细节未知。
  5. 长 CoT 预热与 RL。 对 DeepSeek-R1 和开放来源的 CoT 解答做拒绝采样，保留数千条，并以 LR 2e-5 对 Base 进行预热。基于 Verl 的 GRPO 使用 batch 128、LR 1e-6、temperature 0.6、无 KL、裁剪系数 0.28、逐 token 损失和超长样本过滤，并移除正确率高于 87.5% 的提示。先在 16K 上下文下以每个提示 16 条 rollout 训练 90 步，再在 32K 上下文下以每个提示 32 条 rollout 训练 160 步。

由于缺少提示分批、被丢弃的分组、失败样本和重采样记录，无法重建 GRPO 的总轨迹数；本卡不推断奖励公式或沙箱实现。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The 6T schedule is reported in Section 2.3: 1T code/math web plus 4T curated code at LR 3e-4, followed by 400B continued tokens after a sqrt(10) LR reduction and a final 600B at LR 3e-5. Ingredient disclosures include about 1T retained GitHub tokens, 100B commit tokens, 1.2T code-web tokens, 130B high-quality recalled tokens, and 1T long-context continued-pretraining tokens. These ingredients may overlap; the report does not provide a reconciled source-by-stage matrix.

Section 2.2 reports 74M commits from 140K repositories. The quality scorer trains one epoch on 222,066 oracle-labeled files and tests on 1,178 labels from the same DeepSeek-V2-Chat oracle, with overall MAE 0.91 and category-balanced MAE 1.37 on the original 0-10 scale. This measures oracle imitation; zero-score files remain difficult. The web recall experiment uses 10M candidates, 70/30 seed/validation, 99% recall and 45% precision.

Section 3 reports approximately 3M final SFT pairs, three SFT epochs at LR 2e-5, and approximately 20K on-policy DPO pairs. Section 3.2 reports thousands of warmup traces and GRPO batch 128, LR 1e-6, temperature 0.6, no KL, clip 0.28, 90 steps with 16 rollouts/prompt at 16K, then 160 steps with 32 at 32K. These conditions do not reveal the correctness/format reward equations or total retained trajectories.

The released Reasoning model exposes 65,536-token context; the paper reports that more than 10% of IOI/Codeforces evaluation samples truncate at 64K. The official repository also corrected an inconsistent BigCodeBench setting, showing that evaluation results depend on harness configuration. Scores are not evidence of training-data quality.

第 2.3 节报告了 6T token 的训练安排：1T token 的代码与数学网页数据和 4T token 的精选代码均使用 LR 3e-4；随后 400B 个续训 token 的 LR 降低 sqrt(10) 倍，最后 600B token 使用 LR 3e-5。已披露的数据组成包括约 1T 个保留的 GitHub token、100B 个提交数据 token、1.2T 个代码网页 token、130B 个高质量召回 token，以及 1T 个长上下文续训 token。各集合可能相互重叠，报告没有提供可逐阶段核对的来源矩阵。

第 2.2 节报告从 140K 个代码仓库中获得 74M 次提交。质量评分器在 222,066 个由 DeepSeek-V2-Chat 这一评判模型标注的文件上训练一轮，并在同一评判模型标注的 1,178 个样本上测试；原始 0–10 分制下的总体 MAE 为 0.91，按类别平衡后的 MAE 为 1.37，零分文件仍然难以判断。这些结果衡量的是对评判模型的模仿程度。网页召回实验使用 10M 个候选样本，按 70/30 划分种子集与验证集，召回率为 99%，精确率为 45%。

第 3 节报告最终约有 3M 个 SFT 样本对，SFT 以 LR 2e-5 训练三轮，并得到约 20K 个同策略 DPO 样本对。第 3.2 节报告数千条预热轨迹，以及 GRPO 的 batch 128、LR 1e-6、temperature 0.6、无 KL、裁剪系数 0.28；先在 16K 上下文下以每个提示 16 条 rollout 训练 90 步，再在 32K 上下文下以每个提示 32 条 rollout 训练 160 步。这些条件没有披露正确性与格式奖励公式，也没有给出最终保留的总轨迹数。

发布的 Reasoning 模型上下文长度为 65,536 token；论文称超过 10% 的 IOI/Codeforces 评测样本在 64K 处被截断。官方仓库还修正过不一致的 BigCodeBench 配置，说明评测结果依赖测试框架设置。模型分数本身不能证明训练数据质量。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier code models used GitHub/web corpora, synthetic instructions, execution filtering, preference optimization, and RL. Seed-Coder's distinct contribution is integrating these into one quantified pipeline: external-teacher quality labels distilled into a small scorer, iterative web recall, a 6T curriculum, generated-test self-correction, on-policy DPO, external LongCoT warmup, and target-policy GRPO.

The new data interface is not merely “high-quality code.” It joins source and commit metadata, learned scores, site categories, syntax state, generated instructions/solutions/tests, sandbox outcomes, preference pairs, and long-CoT rewards. Each filter can change the distribution and become an implicit objective.

The title overstates autonomy if read literally. DeepSeek-V2-Chat anchors quality; external LLMs synthesize and evaluate SFT; DeepSeek-R1/open traces initialize reasoning. Target-policy self-improvement appears later. Before reuse, one must audit teacher/scorer bias, independent tests, sandbox exploitability, language/site retention, semantic leakage, and source licenses.

更早代码模型已使用 GitHub/web corpus、synthetic instruction、execution filtering、preference optimization 与 RL。Seed-Coder 的独特贡献是将其整合为一条量化 pipeline：外部 teacher 质量标签蒸馏为小 scorer、迭代 web recall、6T curriculum、generated-test self-correction、on-policy DPO、外部 LongCoT warmup 与目标 policy GRPO。

新的数据接口不只是“高质量代码”。它连接 source/commit metadata、learned score、site category、syntax state、generated instruction/solution/test、sandbox outcome、preference pair 与 long-CoT reward。每个 filter 都会改变分布并成为隐式 objective。

若按字面理解，标题夸大了自治程度。DeepSeek-V2-Chat 锚定质量；外部 LLM 合成和评价 SFT；DeepSeek-R1/open trace 初始化 reasoning；目标 policy 自我改进出现在后期。复用前必须审计 teacher/scorer bias、独立测试、sandbox exploitability、language/site retention、semantic leakage 与 source license。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The scorer inherits category, style, and language bias. Its test labels come from the same DeepSeek-V2-Chat oracle, not humans or execution. It trains on 21 languages but filters 89; per-language thresholds, retention, calibration, and low-resource errors are absent. Relative bottom-10% removal has no disclosed absolute threshold. The paper observes higher web scores for uniformly structured sites and lower scores for forums; category corrections are undisclosed.

FastText recall can amplify this bias. The initial code-web stage reports 99% recall but only 45% precision. Continued-pretraining expands model-selected positives for 2-3 rounds without per-round precision/recall, independent review, drift measurement, or stopping criterion. False positives and teacher preferences can become new positive seeds.

Generated code and generated tests form a correlated feedback loop. The same ecosystem produces solutions, tests, self-corrections, DPO labels, and later executable reward. Weak tests can certify wrong code, encourage test overfitting, and create self-confirming preferences. Sandbox, hidden tests, compilers, time/memory limits, flaky-test policy, exploit controls, correctness aggregation, format parser, reward weights, and normalization are unreleased.

The reported “any 10-gram word overlap” removal is broad but lexical. It cannot establish semantic, translated, paraphrased, solution, generated-test, commit, or repository-level separation. Benchmark versions, tokenization, removed counts, source snapshots, and crawl cutoffs are unknown. The pre-August-2024 LiveCodeBench RL slice versus 2024-10–2025-02 evaluation is only a narrow temporal boundary.

MIT covers released repository code and model weights; it does not relicense GitHub repositories/commits, Common Crawl, StackExchange, WildChat, contests, benchmarks, or derived synthetic records. “Publicly available” and “no personal information” are not source-level permission, attribution, consent, PII-audit, or takedown mechanisms.

评分器会继承类别、文体和语言偏差。测试标签来自同一个 DeepSeek-V2-Chat 评判模型，而非人类判断或程序执行。它只在 21 种语言上训练，却用于过滤 89 种语言；各语言的阈值、保留率、校准结果和低资源语言误差均未披露。移除相对排名末尾 10% 的做法没有绝对质量阈值。论文观察到结构统一的网站得分更高、论坛得分更低，但没有披露类别校正方法。

fastText 召回可能放大偏差。初始代码网页阶段的召回率为 99%，精确率却只有 45%。续训数据经过 2–3 轮由模型选择正例的扩张，但没有给出每轮精确率和召回率、独立复核、漂移测量或停止条件；误报和教师模型偏好可能继续成为新的正例种子。

生成代码与生成测试会形成相关反馈闭环。同一模型生态生成解答、测试、自我修正结果、DPO 标签和后续可执行奖励。较弱的测试可能把错误代码判为正确，诱导对测试的过拟合，并产生自我证明式偏好。沙箱、隐藏测试、编译器、时间与内存限制、不稳定测试处理、漏洞利用控制、正确性汇总方式、格式解析器、奖励权重和归一化方法均未发布。

移除“任意连续 10 个词重叠”的规则覆盖面较广，但只处理词面重叠，无法保证语义、翻译、改写、解答、生成测试、提交或代码仓库层面的隔离。基准版本、分词方式、移除数量、来源快照和抓取截止时间未知。2024 年 8 月前的 LiveCodeBench RL 数据与 2024 年 10 月至 2025 年 2 月的评测之间，只形成了较窄的时间边界。

MIT 仅覆盖发布的代码仓库代码和模型权重，不会重新授权 GitHub 代码仓库与提交、Common Crawl、StackExchange、WildChat、竞赛、基准或衍生合成记录。“公开可用”和“不含个人信息”也不等同于获得来源级许可、提供署名、取得同意、完成个人身份信息审计或建立下架机制。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
This report is a strong construction blueprint when its missing artifacts are treated as requirements. A reproducible implementation should publish source/commit manifests, dedup and Tree-sitter versions, oracle prompts/explanations, scorer weights and per-language calibration, fastText seeds/rounds, category thresholds, and stage mixture accounting.

For SFT/DPO/RL, release generated and independent tests, sandbox images, compiler/runtime matrices, limits, all candidates and failures, preference rules, reward/parser code, and prompt-to-test-to-reward lineage. Ablate external teacher labels, fastText expansion, generated-test correction, DPO, warmup distillation, and GRPO under matched compute.

For audit, compare scorer judgments against humans and execution, measure site/language retention, test semantic/repository leakage beyond 10-grams, and separate code/weight MIT terms from source-data rights.

Reuse class: suitable as a recipe, ablation plan, and audit checklist. Released weights/code support inference research. Training reuse is blocked because the datasets, scorer, tests, sandbox, rewards, full configs, and source licenses are absent.

如果把缺失材料转化为复现要求，这份报告可作为很强的数据构造蓝图。可复现实现应发布来源与提交清单、去重和 Tree-sitter 版本、评判模型的提示与解释、评分器权重及各语言校准结果、fastText 的种子和扩张轮次、类别阈值，以及各训练阶段数据配比的对账表。

SFT、DPO 与 RL 阶段应发布生成测试和独立测试、沙箱镜像、编译器与运行时矩阵、资源限制、全部候选与失败样本、偏好构造规则、奖励与解析代码，以及从提示到测试再到奖励的谱系记录。还应在相同计算量下，分别消融外部教师标签、fastText 扩张、生成测试修正、DPO、预热蒸馏与 GRPO。

审计时应将评分器判断与人类判断或程序执行结果比较，测量不同网站和语言的保留率，采用超越连续 10 词重叠的方法检测语义和代码仓库层面的泄漏，并区分代码与权重的 MIT 许可和来源数据权利。

复用等级：适合作为训练方法、消融方案和审计清单。发布的权重与代码支持推理研究；由于缺少数据集、评分器、测试、沙箱、奖励、完整配置和来源许可证，训练复用仍被阻断。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read “self-curation” as model-centric: DeepSeek-V2-Chat supplies initial quality labels, external LLMs synthesize/evaluate SFT, and DeepSeek-R1/open traces seed LongCoT.
  • Preserve the 6T schedule and its LR conditions separately from overlapping ingredient totals; do not sum ingredient disclosures into a new corpus total.
  • Keep the 222,066-file/1.3B-scorer experiment and the 10M-candidate fastText 99%-recall/45%-precision experiment tied to their teacher-defined labels.
  • Keep 3M SFT, 20K DPO, and GRPO batch 128/temp 0.6/LR 1e-6/clip 0.28/90x16+160x32 conditions attached to their stages.
  • Audit generated-solution/generated-test correlation, fastText feedback amplification, 10-gram decontamination limits, and the fact that MIT does not cover source training data.

• 把“self-curation”读作 model-centric：DeepSeek-V2-Chat 提供初始质量 label，外部 LLM 合成/评价 SFT，DeepSeek-R1/open trace 初始化 LongCoT。
  • 分别保留 6T schedule 与 LR 条件及可能重叠的 ingredient total；不要把 ingredient 披露相加成新的 corpus total。
  • 222,066-file/1.3B-scorer 实验和 10M-candidate fastText 99%-recall/45%-precision 实验都必须绑定 teacher-defined label。
  • 3M SFT、20K DPO，以及 GRPO batch 128/temp 0.6/LR 1e-6/clip 0.28/90x16+160x32 条件必须绑定相应阶段。
  • 重点审计 generated-solution/generated-test 相关性、fastText feedback amplification、10-gram decontamination 边界，以及 MIT 不覆盖源训练数据。

title: Citation
